content.title: What's open on Easter Sunday 2026? Status of Walmart, Target, Aldi, Kohl's, TJ Maxx, Publix, Marshalls, and more
content.text: As Easter Sunday approaches in 2026, many Americans are making final preparations for family gatherings, meals, and celebrations. To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoHowever, those planning last-minute shopping trips should be aware that a significant number of stores and services will either be closed or operating on reduced hours for the holiday.Easter is not a federal holiday in the United States, but it is widely observed by retailers and businesses, leading to a patchwork of closures across the country. Major supermarket chains, retail stores, and even some pharmacies have announced changes to their schedules, making it essential for shoppers to plan ahead.Several well-known retailers are expected to close their doors entirely on Easter Sunday. These typically include big-box stores and membership-based warehouse clubs. While policies can vary by location, companies such as Walmart, Target, and Costco often adjust their hours, with some opting for full closures to allow employees to spend time with family.Grocery stores, in particular, present a mixed picture. Some chains remain open but operate on shortened hours, while others close completely depending on regional management decisions. Smaller, locally owned markets may also choose to shut down for the day, especially in communities where Easter observance is more prominent.Pharmacies and convenience stores are more likely to stay open, though even these businesses may reduce their operating hours. National chains often keep select locations running to provide essential services, but customers should expect limited availability compared to a typical Sunday.Which services are most affected on Easter SundayBeyond retail, a wide range of services will be impacted by Easter closures. Government offices, banks, and postal services generally remain closed on Sundays regardless of the holiday, but Easter can further limit access to certain private-sector services.Restaurants are another area where availability can vary widely. While many chains and independent eateries remain open to accommodate holiday diners, others close or require reservations well in advance due to high demand. Delivery services may also experience delays or limited coverage, particularly in suburban and rural areas.Transportation services, including public transit systems, often operate on modified schedules during Easter. MaxxRetail experts emphasize the importance of preparation, noting that holiday closures can catch shoppers off guard. Many stores post updated hours online in the days leading up to Easter, making it easier for customers to check availability before heading out.In recent years, there has also been a growing trend toward giving retail employees more time off during major holidays. This shift has led to an increase in full-day closures, even among large national chains that previously stayed open year-round.Ultimately, Easter 2026 will see a mix of closures and limited operations across the country. While some businesses will remain open for convenience, many others will shut their doors for the day. For consumers, the key takeaway is simple: plan ahead, shop early, and double-check store hours to avoid any last-minute surprises.
